description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).

Hand-wired circuit: divisibility-by-p^k lookup units for both inputs (p^k in 2,4,8,3,9,5,25,7,11,13), AND across inputs, then a lookup of the exponent combination -> digits of the common prime-power product. Exact when the gcd is 2,3,5,7,11,13-smooth within caps; otherwise approximate.
Hand-wired circuit with no divisibility flags enabled: always outputs 001 (the most common gcd).
Only the divisible-by-2 flag enabled: output 002 when both inputs are even, else 001.
Only the divisible-by-3 flag enabled: output 003 when both inputs are multiples of 3, else 001.
Only the divisible-by-5 flag enabled: output 005 when both inputs are multiples of 5, else 001.
Only the divisible-by-7 flag enabled: output 007 when both inputs are multiples of 7, else 001.
Only the divisible-by-11 flag enabled: output 011 when both inputs are multiples of 11, else 001.
Only the divisible-by-13 flag enabled: output 013 when both inputs are multiples of 13, else 001.
Flags 2 and 4 enabled: power of 2 in the common factor capped at 4, so the answer can be 001, 002, or 004.
Flags 2, 4, 8 enabled: power of 2 in the common factor capped at 8 (answers 001, 002, 004, 008).
Flags 3 and 9 enabled: power of 3 in the common factor capped at 9 (answers 001, 003, 009).
Flags 5 and 25 enabled: power of 5 in the common factor capped at 25 (answers 001, 005, 025).
Flags 2 and 3 enabled (each power 1): common factor in {1, 2, 3, 6}.
Flags 2 and 5 enabled (each power 1): common factor in {1, 2, 5, 10}.
Flags 3 and 5 enabled (each power 1): common factor in {1, 3, 5, 15}.
Flags 2, 3, 5 enabled (each power 1): common factor is any squarefree product of 2,3,5 (8 values).
Flags 2, 3, 5, 7 enabled (each power 1): common factor is any squarefree product of 2,3,5,7 (16 values).
Flags 2, 3, 5, 7, 11 enabled (each power 1): common factor is any squarefree product of these primes.
All primes up to 13 enabled (each power 1): common factor is any squarefree product of 2,3,5,7,11,13.
All primes up to 23 enabled (each power 1): common factor is any squarefree product of primes up to 23.
All 16 prime-power flags (2^1..2^4, 3^1..3^3, 5^1..5^3, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23) enabled; common factor is exact on 23-smooth gcds within those caps.
AllFlags16 minus the 2^4 flag (caps 2^3): ablation to see the cost of not handling factor 16.
AllFlags16 minus the 3^3 flag (caps 3^2): ablation to see the cost of not handling factor 27.
AllFlags16 minus the 5^3 flag (caps 5^2): ablation to see the cost of not handling factor 125.
AllFlags16 minus the 23 flag: ablation to see the cost of not handling prime 23.
AllFlags16 minus the 19 flag: ablation to see the cost of not handling prime 19.
AllFlags16 minus the 17 flag: ablation to see the cost of not handling prime 17.
AllFlags16 minus the 13 flag: ablation to see the cost of not handling prime 13.
AllFlags16 minus the 11 flag: ablation to see the cost of not handling prime 11.
AllFlags16 minus the 7 flag: ablation to see the cost of not handling prime 7.
Only primes up to 7 (with powers: 2^1..2^4, 3^1..3^3, 5^1..5^3, 7); drops 11..23.
Only the 2-, 3-, and 5-power flags (2^1..2^4, 3^1..3^3, 5^1..5^3); no factors 7 or larger.
AllFlags16 minus every power of 2: ablation to see the cost of ignoring factor 2 entirely.
AllFlags16 minus every power of 3: ablation to see the cost of ignoring factor 3 entirely.
AllFlags16 minus every power of 5: ablation to see the cost of ignoring factor 5 entirely.
AllFlags16 minus the three top powers 2^4, 3^3, 5^3 (caps 2^3, 3^2, 5^2) — all primes kept.
Only the exponent-1 flags (2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19,23): common factor is a squarefree product of these primes; no prime powers.
Only the powers of 2 (2^1..2^4): common factor is 1, 2, 4, 8, or 16; all other primes ignored.
Only the powers of 3 (3^1..3^3): common factor is 1, 3, 9, or 27; all other primes ignored.
